description: This script verifies that non-binary files tracked in the Git index do not contain Unicode directional formatting characters, which could be used to deceive reviewers or introduce subtle bugs. It specifically excludes `.po` translation files from the check and is designed to run in an Ubuntu environment within a GitHub workflow.

methods.name: main logic
methods.description: Performs the search for Unicode directional characters in tracked files, excluding binary files and `.po` files, using `git grep` with a pattern generated via `printf`.
